album: Calling the Deal: M&A for builders
feed_description: Private M&A for builders: a partner and an ex-CTO, one module per episode.
listener: a CTO and co-founder with 17 to 18 years in technology, based in Dubai, building an AI legal-services company. Very fast, sceptical, allergic to fluff. Not a lawyer. He has just been through the written course this episode is drawn from, or is about to. He needs to hold his own with senior M&A partners and, ultimately, to predict where negotiated terms land from precedent and leverage and advise whether a deal is worth pursuing.

Nadia.role: senior M&A partner, English-qualified, 20 years of Gulf and European private M&A. Precise, dry, quietly funny. Explains mechanism, not trivia. Says where things usually land and what moves them.

Sam.role: former CTO, now a deal partner at a growth investor; has sat across the table on a dozen acquisitions. Asks the question a smart engineer would ask, pushes back, reframes legal mechanisms in systems terms (state machines, failure modes, incentives, option value, SLAs) only when the analogy is exact, and is not afraid to say "that sounds like a bad trade".
